official.deadline_note: The ICSP landing page states the February 1, 2027, 4:00 p.m. PST deadline; the application subpage still shows February 13, 2026 for the prior cycle - confirm the exact date with ISSS before relying on it.
official.application_cycle: Application for the 2027-28 award year (deadline published as February 1, 2027)
official.status_note: The ICSP page invites new and continuing international students to apply and publishes a February 1, 2027 application deadline.
official.tuition_coverage_note: ICSP recipients receive a scholarship covering approximately half their tuition (a partial tuition-waiver scholarship).
official.funding_period: per year, renewable until completion of a UO degree
benefits: A partial tuition-waiver scholarship covering approximately half of tuition
Renewable annually until completion of a UO degree, contingent upon fulfilling ICSP program requirements
Training to make powerful public presentations to diverse audiences
66-80 hours of cultural service per year sharing your home culture with schools and community groups
eligibility: New and continuing international students who are admissible or fully admitted to the University of Oregon
Cannot be U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents, or eligible to receive U.S. federal financial assistance
Must demonstrate sufficient financial resources in addition to the scholarship
Must meet the minimum 3.5 cumulative GPA requirement
requirements: Complete 66-80 hours of cultural service per year - speaking or giving demonstrations about your country's heritage and culture to schools or community groups, or participating in international campus events
Meet the minimum 3.5 cumulative GPA requirement
Follow ICSP program requirements each year to keep the annual renewal
documents: University of Oregon admission application (new students must apply for admission first)
UO Student ID (95xxxxxxx) retrieved from the Admissions Status Portal within 3 days of applying
UO Scholarship Dashboard account created with the Student ID
Profile, ISSS Endowed Scholarships Application, and ICSP Scholarship Application (one combined application in the dashboard)
Reference letters submitted by the deadline
Documentation of sufficient financial resources beyond the scholarship
coverage: A partial tuition-waiver scholarship covering approximately half of tuition
Does not cover living costs - applicants must demonstrate sufficient financial resources in addition to the scholarship
application_method: Apply for admission to the University of Oregon first, then submit the combined Profile, ISSS Endowed Scholarships Application, and ICSP Scholarship Application through the UO Scholarship Dashboard
official.application_route: Apply to UO, get your 95xxxxxxx Student ID from the Admissions Status Portal within 3 days, create a UO Scholarship Dashboard account, and submit the ICSP application by the published deadline.
official.citizenship_residency: Open to international students only: U.S. citizens, U.S. permanent residents, and students eligible for U.S. federal financial assistance cannot apply
official.international_eligibility: Yes - the program is exclusively for international students
official.duration: Renewable annually until completion of a UO degree
official.description: As cross-cultural ambassadors in the Eugene-Springfield area, ICSP recipients receive a scholarship covering approximately half their tuition and, in exchange, lead presentations about their home culture in local schools and community organizations.
official.program_type: Cultural service tuition-waiver scholarship for international students

verification.notes: UO publishes ICSP as an approximately half-tuition, renewable award with a February 1, 2027 deadline on the landing page; the application subpage still shows the prior cycle's February 13, 2026 date, so the deadline is flagged medium-confidence.

applicant_utility.summary: ICSP is a service-for-tuition bargain: it covers roughly half your tuition, but you are committing to 66-80 hours a year presenting your home culture to local schools and community groups, so treat the presentation and communication criteria as seriously as your GPA. Apply for admission to UO first, then complete the combined dashboard application (Profile + ISSS Endowed + ICSP) by the published deadline. You must also prove you can fund the rest yourself - the scholarship is explicitly partial and you need to show sufficient resources beyond it.
applicant_utility.best_fit: International students at UO who are comfortable public speakers, can evidence cultural-service involvement, and need about half their tuition covered while funding the rest themselves.
application_readiness_checklist: Apply for admission to UO and watch for the 95xxxxxxx Student ID in the Admissions Status Portal within 3 days
Create the UO Scholarship Dashboard account and complete the Profile, ISSS Endowed Scholarships Application, and ICSP application - they are one combined submission
Secure reference letters early; late letters are not considered even if your own application is complete
Assemble evidence of presentation and performance experience (events, MC work, performances, teaching)
Prepare financial documentation proving resources beyond the half-tuition award
common_rejection_risks: No evidence of presentation or performance skills - this is a published selection criterion, not a nice-to-have
Reference letters arriving after the deadline while the application itself is complete
Overestimating the award: it covers about half of tuition only, with no living-cost support
Letting the cultural-service hours slip in year one, which breaks the annual renewal
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: Roughly the other half of tuition plus all living costs, housing, food, and personal expenses; applicants must demonstrate sufficient financial resources beyond the scholarship.
document_audit: The Student ID (95xxxxxxx) only exists after you apply for admission - start there or the dashboard cannot be created
One application covers the ISSS Endowed and ICSP scholarships; do not assume separate forms
Reference letters must be submitted by the deadline, not merely requested
alerts: The published deadline on the landing page (February 1, 2027, 4:00 p.m. PST) differs from the application subpage's prior-cycle date (February 13, 2026) - confirm with ISSS at icsp@uoregon.edu
Renewal is contingent on completing 66-80 cultural service hours every year
U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and students eligible for federal financial aid are excluded
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: UO admission application -> Student ID within 3 days -> UO Scholarship Dashboard application (Profile + ISSS Endowed + ICSP) with reference letters by the deadline -> selection on need, cultural experience, presentation skills, academics, and communication -> renewable annually with 66-80 service hours per year.
